fnol_text: My name is Tomas Raman and I live at 898 Larkspur Avenue, Dover, DE 19975. You can reach me on (555) 609-7545 or tomas.raman@example.com. Heavy rain all afternoon on 16 August 2024. Water pooled on the lawn and then came into the lounge at floor level. Carpets and the sofa are soaked. Policy HH-2023-00011. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Raman on (555) 609-7545 to acknowledge the claim. Tomas confirmed the loss date as 16 August 2024.
Site visit to 898 Larkspur Avenue. Neighbour Kwame Okafor was present and confirmed the timeline.
Tomas sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
